subject: Intro: quick technical demo & capacity check for Redwood inference
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@finpilot.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Redwood — quick pilot & demo request

Hi Alex,

I signed up for a trial yesterday (FinPilot) and I was hoping to schedule a short demo to see how Redwood would fit our inference needs. A few details up front to help scope the call:

- Use case: customer support summarization + intent classification + result reranking for internal search.
- Expected volume: ~500M tokens/month in steady state; initial pilot ~10M tokens/month.
- Peak patterns: batch jobs overnight + spiky real-time traffic during business hours (US PST).
- Timeline: pilot starting in ~4–6 weeks, production in 3–4 months if pilot looks good.

Would appreciate 30 minutes to cover performance expectations, cost estimates, and a quick walkthrough of the integration (API + SDK).

Attaching a quick traffic spreadsheet that our infra team filled out.

Thanks,
Samir
Director of Engineering
FinPilot
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finpilot.io>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — quick pilot & demo request

Hi Samir — thanks for the signup and the context, this is helpful. Happy to set up a short session. Before I book time, two quick probes so we tailor the demo and bring the right folks: 

1) Which models are you expecting to run (open model / LLM family)? If unsure, high-level requirements (generation length, response latency target) are fine.
2) For the pilot: are you planning to use Hosted API or do you need a Dedicated/Private option for data isolation?
3) Any specific compliance needs (SOC 2, data retention, encryption at rest)?

Proposed 30-min slots (PST) — pick one or tell me a better window: 
- Mon, 31 May 9:00–9:30
- Tue, 1 Jun 11:30–12:00
- Wed, 2 Jun 14:00–14:30

I’ll loop in our Solutions Engineer (Monica) for a short technical portion and Ben (SDR) will handle mutual next steps.

If you prefer, here’s a Calendly link to pick a time: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min?month=May-2027

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0129
From: Samir Patel <samir@finpilot.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@finpilot.io>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — quick pilot & demo request

Alex — thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications: 

- Models: leaning toward a 7B open model to start (shorter generations, 200–400 tokens typical), but we may evaluate larger families if latency/costs allow.
- Deployment: prefer Hosted initially for speed; we will evaluate Dedicated if we need isolation after pilot.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II is a yes; also want to understand log retention and KMS options.

The team attached the traffic estimate (finpilot_traffic_estimates_Q2.xlsx).

Tue 1 Jun at 11:30 PST works for Priya and me. Can you make sure a technical person can talk about batching and KV cache behavior? Also, can you share a short agenda so we can invite our product engineer?

—Samir

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — quick pilot & demo request

Perfect — locking Tue, 1 Jun 11:30–12:00 PST for a 30-min walkthrough. Invites will follow.

Agenda (30 min):
- 0–5m: Introductions & goals for pilot (Samir/Priya)
- 5–15m: High-level Redwood architecture & hosting options (Alex)
- 15–25m: Technical deep dive: batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs (Monica)
- 25–30m: Next steps & mutual action items (Ben)

Prep notes for your product engineer:
- We’ll demo a short API call (generation + embeddings) and show token-level latency/cost breakdown.
- Monica will explain how caching reduces per-token cost for conversational flows and how we recommend sizing batch windows for 7B models.

Attachments: proposed_demo_agenda.docx, SOC2_questions.pdf

If anything changes on your side, reply here and we’ll reschedule. Otherwise, you should see a calendar invite from our system.

Thanks — looking forward,
Alex

Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — quick pilot & demo request

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Tue, 1 Jun 11:30–12:00 PST. Calendar invite accepted.

Quick ask before the call: could you send a brief note on what telemetry/logs Redwood exposes by default (request traces, token-level logs, storage duration) so our security PM can scan? If easier, pointing to a short doc is fine — otherwise the SOC2_questions.pdf we attached has the top items we need.

See you Tuesday.

—Samir
